_comment: Subway 'World Cup Week' scripted demo flow. Gated to SUBWAY_PHONE. Copy/steps are data-only; edit freely. Engine: src/scriptedFlow.js. Story: kickoff banner -> product swap to Chicken Tikka (clearing excess stock) -> discount pushback (50% asked, 30% HQ cap held, with a keep-30%/change-offer choice) -> updated banner -> channel picker. Each banner's own message is addressed to the DEALER and sent BEFORE the image; the image's caption is the ready-to-forward CUSTOMER-facing copy, so dealer context and customer copy never land in the same bubble.
